The '''Droid Modification Team''' was a group of [[2-1B surgical droid/Legends|2-1B surgical droids]] that specialized in repairing [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and replacing their parts. The team was affiliated with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and,<ref name="Glove" /> in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the [[Trioculus affair]], which includes the preparation for the [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|mission]] to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] involving the Droid Modification Team, in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].</ref> was tasked with disguising the droids [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] in preparation for an undercover [[Mission to Kessel (Trioculus affair)|mission]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]].<ref name="Glove" />

The Droid Modification Team disguised R2-D2 first while C-3PO waited with the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in the [[Droid Repair Shop (Yavin 4)|Droid Repair Shop]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Skywalker signaled the team with an [[inter-office communications device]] after some protestations from C-3PO, and the droids brought in R2-D2, whom they had modified to resemble a [[Color/Legends|dark green]] [[Kesselian spice-mining droid|Kessel mining droid]]. C-3PO then reluctantly left with the Droid Modification Team and was modified within an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]], after which he returned to the Droid Repair Shop.<ref name="Glove" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Droid Modification Team appeared in ''[[The Glove of Darth Vader]]'', a [[1992]] junior novel by [[Paul Davids|Paul]] and [[Hollace Davids]].<ref name="Glove" />
